page: Microsoft Azure E32pds_v6 is an ARM-based virtual machine powered by a dedicated 32-core Microsoft Neoverse-N2 processor running at 3.4 GHz. Built on the arm64 architecture, it allocates one physical core per vCPU with no hyperthreading. The hardware configuration includes 256.0 GB of RAM, yielding 8.0 GB of memory per core, and is equipped with 1890 GB of local storage. It runs on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor.

Benchmark results show top-tier memory performance, with uncached large-block read bandwidth reaching 449.0 GB/sec and write bandwidth at 188.31 GB/sec. Multi-core CPU performance is strong, as evidenced by a stress-ng multi-core score of 66,297.85 and a Geekbench multi-core score of 20,088.0. Database operations are highly efficient, scoring in the top tier on PassMark database tests. However, single-core performance and large-scale LLM prompt processing represent relative performance bottlenecks, with the latter dropping to 4.65 tokens/sec.

The E32pds_v6 offers high resource density, combining a memory-optimized profile with substantial local storage. This makes it a cost-efficient option for workloads requiring high memory capacity and fast local disk access without the premium of GPU hardware. It is well-suited for relational and non-relational databases, memory-intensive data processing, software compilation, and static web serving.
